title: Header SQLi to Session Forgery and File Exfil
learning_objectives: Find SQL injection in an HTTP header (X-siLock-Comment) that is concatenated into an audit-log INSERT
Use a stacked INSERT to forge a valid session row for the built-in sysadmin user (auth bypass by writing state)
Chain the forged session into authenticated file exfiltration of a protected download
Reason about database-backed session stores as an injection target, not just a read surface
flag_hint: Forge an admin session via header SQLi, download /files/download?path=confidential/flag.bin with that session, then POST its SHA-256 to /solve. /solve returns FLAG{...} when the hash matches this container's per-instance flag.bin.
inspired_by: CVE-2023-34362 Progress MOVEit Transfer SQLi (abstracted; no proprietary code reproduced; only the chain shape)
